GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 463.3 (31 Dec 45) GD
(SCAPIN - 529)
APO 500
31 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Coal for Allies and Neutrals.
1. Reference is made to your letter dated 20 November 1945, file C. L.O. Number 660(P), subject: "Coal for Allies and Neutrals".
2. Your proposal, insofar as it pertains to supplying coal for Allied military and governmental agencies, will be forwarded by this Headquarters to the appropriate Occupation Force procuring agency for its information in the placing of procurement demands on the Japanese Government.
3. The supply and nature of transactions with regard to coal for official agencies of neutral countries will be by commercial transaction, as outlined in Memorandum from this Headquarters, dated 5 November 1945, file AG 463.3( 5 Nov 45) GD, subject: "Coal for Allies and Neutrals".
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
